## Best Parameters

```{r opt-best}
# Select best combination by Omega (K already fixed at 3)
best <- opt_results %>% slice_max(omega, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

cat(sprintf(
  "Best combination (Omega = %.3f):\n  K = %d (fixed) | N_LONG = %d | VIX_THRESHOLD = %d | DD_STOP = %.0f%%\n  CAGR = %.1f%% | Sharpe = %.3f | Max DD = %.1f%%\n",
  best$omega, K_CLUSTERS, best$N_LONG, best$VIX_THRESHOLD,
  best$DD_STOP * 100,
  best$cagr * 100, best$sharpe, best$max_dd * 100
))

# Lock in selected parameters — used by test period section
N_LONG        <- best$N_LONG
VIX_THRESHOLD <- best$VIX_THRESHOLD
DD_STOP       <- best$DD_STOP
DD_PARTIAL    <- DD_STOP / 2   # partial re-entry zone: halfway to full stop
```

---

# Test Period

Out-of-sample evaluation using parameters locked from training. The expanding window continues from where training ended — each test-month rebalancing refits K-means on all data (training + test so far), so the regime model adapts as new information arrives without ever looking ahead.

Normalisation uses the **training-period recipe** (`cluster_prep`) applied to test features — training mean/sd are used for scaling, preventing data leakage.

## Feature Extension & Signal Generation

```{r test-setup}
# Extend Layer 1 cluster input to test period
# Use training recipe (cluster_prep) to normalise — no leakage
test_cluster_input <- features_kf %>%
  filter(date >= TEST_START, date <= TEST_END) %>%
  select(date, all_of(cluster_cols)) %>%
  drop_na()

test_cluster_mat <- bake(cluster_prep,
                         new_data = test_cluster_input %>% select(-date)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Full expanding window: training + test rows
full_cluster_input <- bind_rows(cluster_input, test_cluster_input)
full_cluster_mat   <- rbind(cluster_mat, test_cluster_mat)

# Test rebalancing dates: month-end trading days in test window
test_rebal_dates <- test_cluster_input %>%
  mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(ym) %>%
  slice_max(date, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  pull(date)

# Trading days in test window
test_dates <- raw_data %>%
  filter(ticker == "SPY", date >= TEST_START, date <= TEST_END) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  pull(date)

cat(sprintf("%d test rebalancing dates | %d trading days\n",
            length(test_rebal_dates), length(test_dates)))
```

```{r test-signals}
# Two-layer signals for test period
# Layer 1 expanding window continues from training; Layer 2 runs inline
test_signals <- map_dfr(seq_along(test_rebal_dates), function(i) {
  two_layer_signal(test_rebal_dates[i], i, N_LONG, N_SHORT, VIX_THRESHOLD,
                    full_cluster_input, full_cluster_mat,
                    seed_offset = 1000L)
})

glimpse(test_signals)
```

## P&L

```{r test-pnl}
# Execution map: first trading day after each test rebal_date
test_exec_map <- tibble(rebal_date = test_rebal_dates) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(exec_date = {
    cands <- test_dates[test_dates > rebal_date]
    if (length(cands) == 0) NA_Date_ else cands[1]
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(exec_date))

# Daily positions (forward-fill signals from exec_date)
test_daily_signals <- test_signals %>%
  select(rebal_date, ticker, signal) %>%
  inner_join(test_exec_map, by = "rebal_date") %>%
  select(date = exec_date, ticker, signal)

test_daily_pos <- expand_grid(date = test_dates, ticker = sector_tickers) %>%
  left_join(test_daily_signals, by = c("date", "ticker")) %>%
  arrange(ticker, date) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  fill(signal, .direction = "down") %>%
  mutate(signal = replace_na(signal, 0L)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Close-to-close returns for test period
test_daily_rets <- raw_data %>%
  filter(ticker %in% sector_tickers, date %in% test_dates) %>%
  arrange(ticker, date) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  mutate(ret_cc = Close / dplyr::lag(Close) - 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, ticker, ret_cc)

# TC on weight turnover
test_rebal_costs <- compute_weights(test_daily_pos) %>%
  arrange(ticker, date) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  mutate(prev_weight = dplyr::lag(weight, default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(tc = sum(abs(weight - prev_weight), na.rm = TRUE) * TC_BPS, .groups = "drop")

# First-pass P&L
test_pnl1 <- compute_weights(test_daily_pos) %>%
  left_join(test_daily_rets, by = c("date", "ticker")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(ret_gross = sum(weight * replace_na(ret_cc, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            n_long = first(n_long), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(test_rebal_costs, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(tc = replace_na(tc, 0),
         ret   = ret_gross - tc,
         cumeq = cumprod(1 + ret))

# -- Second pass: scaled exposure (B + C) --
# Scale factor per month:
#   dd >= DD_PARTIAL              → 1.0  (full exposure)
#   DD_STOP <= dd < DD_PARTIAL    → 0.5  (partial re-entry zone)
#   dd < DD_STOP & VIX > VIX_REENTRY → 0.0  (fully flat)
#   dd < DD_STOP & VIX <= VIX_REENTRY → 0.5  (VIX recovery override)
# Uninvested fraction (1 - scale) earns rf_daily each day.

vix_daily <- features_wide %>% select(date, vix)

test_month_end_scale <- test_pnl1 %>%
  mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(ym) %>% slice_max(date, n = 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  left_join(vix_daily, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    peak  = cummax(cumeq),
    dd    = (cumeq - peak) / peak,
    # Base scale from drawdown level
    scale = case_when(
      dd >= DD_PARTIAL                              ~ 1.0,
      dd >= DD_STOP & dd < DD_PARTIAL               ~ 0.5,
      TRUE                                          ~ 0.0
    ),
    # VIX recovery override (C): if fully flat but VIX normalises, unlock 50%
    scale = if_else(scale == 0 & !is.na(vix) & vix <= VIX_REENTRY, 0.5, scale),
    next_ym_scale = as.numeric(dplyr::lead(scale, default = 1.0))
  ) %>%
  mutate(ym = floor_date(date %m+% months(1), "month")) %>%
  select(ym, next_ym_scale)

# Attach scale to daily positions (signals unchanged — scaling applied to weights)
test_daily_pos_scaled <- test_daily_pos %>%
  mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  left_join(test_month_end_scale, by = "ym") %>%
  mutate(next_ym_scale = replace_na(next_ym_scale, 1.0)) %>%
  select(-ym)

# TC on scaled weight turnover
test_rc_scaled <- compute_weights(test_daily_pos_scaled) %>%
  mutate(weight_s = weight * next_ym_scale) %>%
  arrange(ticker, date) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  mutate(prev_ws = dplyr::lag(weight_s, default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(tc = sum(abs(weight_s - prev_ws), na.rm = TRUE) * TC_BPS, .groups = "drop")

# Second-pass P&L: sectors earn scaled return; uninvested earns rf_daily
test_pnl2 <- compute_weights(test_daily_pos_scaled) %>%
  mutate(weight_s = weight * next_ym_scale) %>%
  left_join(test_daily_rets, by = c("date", "ticker")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    ret_sectors = sum(weight_s * replace_na(ret_cc, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    dd_scale    = first(next_ym_scale),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(test_rc_scaled, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(rf_daily,       by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    tc       = replace_na(tc, 0),
    rf_daily = replace_na(rf_daily, 0),
    # Uninvested portion earns rf_daily; fully flat = only rf
    ret_gross = ret_sectors + (1 - dd_scale) * rf_daily,
    # TC on rf entry/exit only when transitioning to/from fully flat
    fully_flat = dd_scale == 0,
    rf_tc = if_else(
      (fully_flat & !dplyr::lag(fully_flat, default = FALSE)) |
      (!fully_flat &  dplyr::lag(fully_flat, default = FALSE)),
      TC_BPS, 0),
    ret   = ret_gross - tc - rf_tc,
    cumeq = cumprod(1 + ret)
  )

# SPY buy-and-hold for test period
test_spy_bh <- raw_data %>%
  filter(ticker == "SPY", date %in% test_dates) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(ret_cc    = Close / dplyr::lag(Close) - 1,
         cumeq_spy = cumprod(1 + replace_na(ret_cc, 0))) %>%
  select(date, cumeq_spy, ret_cc_spy = ret_cc)

test_perf <- test_pnl2 %>%
  select(date, cumeq, ret, rf_daily, dd_scale) %>%
  mutate(dd_scale = as.numeric(dd_scale)) %>%
  left_join(test_spy_bh, by = "date")

cat(sprintf(
  "Strategy: %.1f%%  |  SPY B&H: %.1f%%\nMonths fully flat: %d  |  Months at 50%%: %d  |  Months full: %d\n",
  (last(test_perf$cumeq) - 1) * 100,
  (last(test_perf$cumeq_spy) - 1) * 100,
  sum(test_perf$dd_scale == 0,   na.rm = TRUE) %/% 21,
  sum(test_perf$dd_scale == 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) %/% 21,
  sum(test_perf$dd_scale == 1.0, na.rm = TRUE) %/% 21
))
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r test-chart-cumeq}
# Shade background by exposure scale
scale_regions <- test_perf %>%
  mutate(
    exposure_label = case_when(
      near(dd_scale, 0)   ~ "Flat (rf only)",
      near(dd_scale, 0.5) ~ "50% exposure",
      TRUE                ~ "Full exposure"
    )
  )

plot_ly(test_perf, x = ~date) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~cumeq,     name = "Strategy (net TC + scaled DD)",
            line = list(color = "#4e79a7", width = 2)) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~cumeq_spy, name = "SPY Buy & Hold",
            line = list(color = "#e15759", width = 2, dash = "dash")) %>%
  add_lines(data = filter(scale_regions, near(dd_scale, 0)),
            x = ~date, y = ~cumeq,
            name = "Fully flat periods", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(color = "orange", size = 4, opacity = 0.6)) %>%
  add_lines(data = filter(scale_regions, near(dd_scale, 0.5)),
            x = ~date, y = ~cumeq,
            name = "50% exposure periods", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(color = "#f28e2b", size = 4, opacity = 0.6)) %>%
  layout(
    title     = list(text = "Test Period Cumulative Return (Out-of-Sample) — Partial Re-entry + VIX Gate",
                     font = list(size = 14)),
    xaxis     = list(title = NULL, type = "date"),
    yaxis     = list(title = "Cumulative Return (1.0 = start)", tickformat = ".2f"),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend    = list(x = 0.01, y = 0.99, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)")
  )
```

## Drawdown

```{r test-chart-dd}
test_dd <- test_perf %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(peak_strat = cummax(cumeq),
         peak_spy   = cummax(cumeq_spy),
         dd_strat   = (cumeq     - peak_strat) / peak_strat,
         dd_spy     = (cumeq_spy - peak_spy)   / peak_spy)

mdd_strat <- test_dd %>% slice_min(dd_strat, n = 1)
mdd_spy   <- test_dd %>% slice_min(dd_spy,   n = 1)

plot_ly(test_dd, x = ~date) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~dd_strat, name = "Strategy",
            line = list(color = "#4e79a7", width = 2)) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~dd_spy,   name = "SPY Buy & Hold",
            line = list(color = "#e15759", width = 2, dash = "dash")) %>%
  add_markers(data = mdd_strat, x = ~date, y = ~dd_strat,
              name = paste0("Strategy MDD: ", scales::percent(mdd_strat$dd_strat, accuracy = 0.1)),
              marker = list(color = "#4e79a7", size = 10, symbol = "circle-open",
                            line = list(width = 2))) %>%
  add_markers(data = mdd_spy, x = ~date, y = ~dd_spy,
              name = paste0("SPY MDD: ", scales::percent(mdd_spy$dd_spy, accuracy = 0.1)),
              marker = list(color = "#e15759", size = 10, symbol = "circle-open",
                            line = list(width = 2))) %>%
  add_segments(x = ~min(date), xend = ~max(date),
               y = DD_STOP, yend = DD_STOP, inherit = FALSE,
               line = list(color = "orange", width = 1, dash = "dot"),
               name = paste0("DD stop (", scales::percent(DD_STOP), ")")) %>%
  layout(
    title     = list(text = "Test Period Drawdown from Peak", font = list(size = 14)),
    xaxis     = list(title = NULL, type = "date"),
    yaxis     = list(title = "Drawdown", tickformat = ".0%"),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend    = list(x = 0.01, y = 0.01, bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)")
  )
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r test-stats}
n_test_days  <- nrow(test_perf)
n_test_years <- n_test_days / 252

test_rets  <- replace_na(test_perf$ret, 0)
test_rf    <- replace_na(test_perf$rf_daily, 0)
test_spy   <- replace_na(test_perf$ret_cc_spy, 0)
excess_t   <- test_rets - test_rf
excess_spy <- test_spy  - test_rf

test_peak     <- cummax(test_perf$cumeq)
test_peak_spy <- cummax(test_perf$cumeq_spy)
test_mdd      <- min((test_perf$cumeq     - test_peak)     / test_peak,     na.rm = TRUE)
test_mdd_spy  <- min((test_perf$cumeq_spy - test_peak_spy) / test_peak_spy, na.rm = TRUE)
test_total    <- last(test_perf$cumeq)     - 1
test_total_spy<- last(test_perf$cumeq_spy) - 1

tibble(
  Metric    = c("Total Return", "CAGR", "Ann. Volatility", "Sharpe", "Omega (L=0)",
                "Max Drawdown", "MDD Date", "Period"),
  Strategy  = c(
    scales::percent(test_total, accuracy = 0.1),
    scales::percent((1 + test_total)^(1/n_test_years) - 1, accuracy = 0.1),
    scales::percent(sd(test_rets, na.rm = TRUE) * sqrt(252), accuracy = 0.1),
    round((mean(excess_t,   na.rm=TRUE)/sd(excess_t,   na.rm=TRUE))*sqrt(252), 3),
    round(sum(pmax(test_rets,0))/sum(pmax(-test_rets,0)), 3),
    scales::percent(test_mdd, accuracy = 0.1),
    format(test_perf$date[which.min((test_perf$cumeq - test_peak)/test_peak)], "%Y-%m-%d"),
    paste(format(TEST_START, "%Y-%m-%d"), "–", format(TEST_END, "%Y-%m-%d"))
  ),
  `SPY B&H` = c(
    scales::percent(test_total_spy, accuracy = 0.1),
    scales::percent((1 + test_total_spy)^(1/n_test_years) - 1, accuracy = 0.1),
    scales::percent(sd(test_spy, na.rm = TRUE) * sqrt(252), accuracy = 0.1),
    round((mean(excess_spy, na.rm=TRUE)/sd(excess_spy, na.rm=TRUE))*sqrt(252), 3),
    round(sum(pmax(test_spy,0))/sum(pmax(-test_spy,0)), 3),
    scales::percent(test_mdd_spy, accuracy = 0.1),
    format(test_perf$date[which.min((test_perf$cumeq_spy-test_peak_spy)/test_peak_spy)], "%Y-%m-%d"),
    paste(format(TEST_START, "%Y-%m-%d"), "–", format(TEST_END, "%Y-%m-%d"))
  )
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Test Period Performance Summary (Out-of-Sample)",
               align = "lrr")
```

## Monthly Signal Diagnostic

```{r test-monthly-diag}
test_monthly_diag <- test_signals %>%
  select(rebal_date, ticker, signal, avg_ret, regime, sector_cluster) %>%
  group_by(rebal_date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_long  = sum(signal == 1L),
    n_flat  = sum(signal == 0L),
    longs   = paste(ticker[signal == 1L], collapse = ", "),
    regime  = first(regime),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(features_wide %>% select(date, vix), by = c("rebal_date" = "date")) %>%
  left_join(
    test_pnl2 %>%
      mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
      group_by(ym) %>%
      summarise(month_ret = prod(1 + ret) - 1, .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(rebal_date = ym + months(1) - days(1)),
    by = "rebal_date"
  ) %>%
  select(rebal_date, regime, vix, n_long, longs, month_ret)

print(test_monthly_diag, n = 30)
```
